During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] '''attacked''' the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]].<ref name="TEA" /> In response to the failed [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|Operation Trinity]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], the Yuuzhan Vong launched an offensive against [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. The [[Hakassi]] and [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Kuat shipyards]] were first targeted.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Soon after self-proclaimed [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Pwoe]] visited [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], the planet fell to the Yuuzhan Vong. During the invasion, the Vong managed to catch many wealthy and influential families from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] who had fled their invaded world.<ref name="TUF" /> After Kuat and Hakassi, the Yuuzhan Vong moved to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked]] the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
